summary: Iteration 12 (FRONTEND-ONLY per request) — 4 new features tested end-to-end on Expo web at 390x844 as elite@test.com. RESULTS: (1) BOSS QUESTS ✅ — tapping the '☠ BOSS' chip on /quests renders BOTH boss quests (SLAY THE GATEKEEPER + CLAIM THE THRONE) with reward labels 'BOSS Frame + 600 XP' and 'Boss Throne BG + 700 XP'; tapping 'ALL' also shows a 'BOSS QUESTS' section header with the same 2 quests below the daily/weekly/monthly sections. (2) JUDGE segmented toggle ✅ — /judge screen renders 'THE LINEUP' and '🏆 TOP THIS WEEK' toggle (testIDs judge-view-feed / judge-view-board); switching to TOP THIS WEEK shows the correct empty-state text 'No scored physiques this week yet. Submit one to top the board.' (backend GET /api/judge/leaderboard returns [] since no scored subs in last 7 days). (3) ★ BACKER pill ✅ — after temporarily setting founder_backer=true on elite in Mongo and reloading, ME tab player card renders a golden '★ BACKER' pill next to the '✓ SKOOL' pill (see line 117 in profile.tsx). (4) PROGRAM DELIVERY — partial: temporarily set all_rooms_access=true + custom_program_purchased=true on elite in Mongo, then created an intake via POST /api/custom-program/unlock + /intake. On /custom-program the 'COACH INBOX — DELIVER PROGRAMS' button (testID=cp-coach-inbox) appears; tapping opens /coach-programs which renders 'DELIVER PROGRAMS' with 1 coach-req-<id> card showing goals/schedule/contact + 'UPLOAD PROGRAM FILE' button. Playwright expect_file_chooser + set_files delivered a real .pdf; the card immediately flipped to status pill 'DELIVERED', '✓ Delivered: program.pdf', and the toast 'Delivered to Kaido.' rendered. Backend then correctly reflects intake.status='delivered', program_media_id + program_file_name populated on GET /api/custom-program. BUT the buyer-side confirm view in /custom-program does NOT render — the '⬇ DOWNLOAD YOUR PROGRAM' button (testID=cp-download) never appears because GET /api/custom-program returns 401 in-browser (root cause below). Restored temporary flags + deleted the test intake at the end. No red screens; only cosmetic textShadow*/shadow*/pointerEvents deprecation warnings carried over.

ui_bugs.issue: GET /api/custom-program is called on mount with an undefined bearer token → 401 → catch clause forces setView('offer') → the '⬇ DOWNLOAD YOUR PROGRAM' button (cp-download) never renders even though the backend has program_media_id set. Verified in browser: response log shows '401 https://.../api/custom-program' immediately followed by BUY NOW rendering; the same curl succeeds server-side.

integration_issues.issue: custom-program.tsx line 72-76 useEffect has deps=[] and eslint-disable-next-line — it fires loadStatus() before the auth token from useAuth() hydrates on web, so the first (and only) call to /api/custom-program 401s and the screen falls back to the OFFER view. Fix: either add `token` to the deps array so loadStatus re-runs once token arrives, OR guard `if (!token) return;` and re-fire when token becomes truthy.

rca_of_issue: Buyer-side cp-download button missing after successful delivery: /app/frontend/app/custom-program.tsx lines 72-76 → useEffect(()=>{ setContactValue(...); loadStatus(); }, []) with an ESLint override to suppress deps. loadStatus() awaits apiFetch(token, '/api/custom-program'), but on web the `token` from useAuth() hydrates from AsyncStorage asynchronously; on first mount `token` is still undefined so the fetch hits /api/custom-program with no Authorization header → 401 → catch clause forces setView('offer'). Because deps=[] the effect never re-runs when token arrives, so the offer view stays and the confirm/download view never renders. Fix: change deps to `[token]` (guarding with `if (!token) return;` at the top of loadStatus) OR keep the effect empty but await token via a second effect that fires when token becomes truthy. Reproduction: (1) mongo-set custom_program_purchased=true + create intake + deliver; (2) reload /custom-program in the web preview; (3) observe network 401 on /api/custom-program and offer view rendering with BUY NOW.
